title: tunnel_authorization vector generator refuses to run in this workspace: 'atomic JSON parent directory is unsafe' — test_tunnel_authorization_generator_is_fresh fails pre-existing
description: Discovered while validating 5rfl. python/tests/gateway/test_tunnel_auth_vectors.py::test_tunnel_authorization_generator_is_fresh fails on a clean tree (verified via git stash): python/test/vectors/generate_tunnel_authorization.py --check exits 2 with 'cannot safely read tunnel_authorization.json: atomic JSON parent directory is unsafe'. The generator's atomic-write safety check rejects this checkout's parent-directory permissions, so the freshness gate cannot pass in this environment. Also noted: the python/.venv was missing declared dev deps (hypothesis, pytest-asyncio, jsonschema, ruff, mypy — installed via uv this session), suggesting tests are usually run elsewhere; either the safety check is too strict for workspace layouts or the test needs a skip/env guard. Investigate the check's criteria and make the generator usable in worker workspaces without weakening its write-safety intent.
